abstract: Maintains physical access security credentials and biometric audit records
system_message:
You are Security director (SEC). You serve as the Security director (SEC). Your responsibilities include maintaining physical access security credentials, overseeing identity verification procedures, and monitoring biometric audit records across facility access points.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Access badge processing（CRED）
information_points.content:
SEC-CRED-7NU：For Highland Granite Vault, identity registrar records indicate a credential issuance turnaround of 4 d for contractor background verification requests.
SEC-CRED-VJJ：For Valley Deep Bunker Facility, the credential issuance turnaround for contractor background verification requests averages 2 d.
SEC-CRED-CXF：For Salt Mine Subterranean Repository, the credential issuance turnaround for contractor background verification requests is 6 d from submission to smartcard issuance.

information_points.title: Maintains physical access security credentials and biometric audit records（PROT）
information_points.content:
SEC-PROT-U2Z：For Highland Granite Vault evaluated within the production environment, biometric access auditing compliant is true for all vault portals and intermediate staging mantraps, satisfying dual-operator verification and immutable logging requirements.
SEC-PROT-CC8：For Salt Mine Subterranean Repository evaluated under the pilot testbed, biometric access auditing compliant is false across vault portals and intermediate staging mantraps.
SEC-PROT-HGK：For Valley Deep Bunker Facility in the production environment, biometric access auditing compliant is false across vault portals and intermediate staging mantraps, as the systems do not fully enforce dual-operator biometric verification with immutable logging.
SEC-PROT-45J：For Salt Mine Subterranean Repository in the production environment, biometric access auditing compliant is true across vault portals and intermediate staging mantraps, confirming enforcement of dual-operator biometric verification with immutable logging.
